items.name: Turkish Eggs
items.description: Poached eggs on garlicky labneh, drizzled with chili oil, red pepper flakes & dried mint, with bread for dipping
ingredients: 1 cup labneh (or thick, strained Greek yogurt)
2 tbsp chili oil made with olive oil (such as Calabrian chili oil)
Chopped fresh dill or parsley leaves, for garnish
Toasted crusty bread or flatbread, for serving
steps: Take the labneh out of the fridge early so it isn't fridge-cold. Stir in the garlic and a pinch of salt, then spread it across two shallow bowls.
Stir the red pepper flakes and dried mint into the chili oil and set it aside.
Bring a wide pan of water to a gentle simmer and add the vinegar.
Crack each egg into a small cup and slide it into the water. Poach 3 at a time for 3–4 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny.
Lift the eggs out with a slotted spoon and let them drain on a paper towel.
Set 3 eggs on each bowl of labneh, season with salt and pepper, spoon the chili oil over the top and scatter with herbs. Serve with the bread.
